verdict.rationale: Mintlify has a dedicated preview-deployments page promising unique preview URLs for each pull request, so reviewers can see changes in a live environment before merging. That is backed by a REST endpoint to create or redeploy a branch preview and by editor docs on previewing and sharing changes with the team. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that previews are created automatically for every PR, and details on how preview links are shared and access-controlled.
